imageCredits.title: The sun rising over two sleeping rhinos
The antlers of deer that look like tree branches
Elephants showering the trees with water
A crocodile resting beside a river
A bird guiding its young ones across painted skies
A blue owl with wide eyes in against the night sky
An elephant and turtle bowing to the dawn of a new day
